scope: Independent synthetic physical-coordinate and permitted-observation boundary review

boundary_regression.problem: Exact source-grid corners transformed to physical mm and back are spuriously outside strict normalized bounds due to inverse-affine roundoff.
boundary_regression.resolution: Policy world-to-grid conversion canonicalizes only values within 64 float64 eps of normalized +1 or -1; all larger outside samples remain outside. The numerical band is recorded in the architecture contract.

before_fix.physical_affine: oblique anisotropic basis with translation [17,-31,8], spacing [1.5,2.75,4]

integrated_precision_probe.resolution: Owner preserves action_geometry and state_features as float64 through DTO and inverse-affine conversion, casting only normalized model inputs to float32. Forward ray features also multiply the authoritative pre-cast inbounds flags.
integrated_precision_probe.regression_result: Four end-to-end tests passed 1.03 s after repair; no prior pytest failure is claimed for this diagnostic probe.

coverage: Analytic noncubic phantom detects stored XYZ versus torch grid ZYX ordering.
Exact and fractional points preserve known scalar fields under anisotropic, oblique and reflected physical affines.
Five path points retain entry-to-tip order and nonzero finite image gradients.
Material outside samples are exact zero rather than partial border interpolation; nonfinite points/frames fail.
Exact physical corners and complete boundary rays remain covered after float64 inverse transforms.
Outside status is retained even when normalized model coordinates round to a float32 boundary.
Missing nominal target remains distinct from known-zero target in actual actor value/coverage/availability tensors.
Synthetic-scan and inference-only tracks reject supplied target/motor/language annotations, including direct DTO replacement.
Direct DTO forgery of missingness, coverage, spacing or source provenance is rejected; mutable tensor replacement is refused.
Input intensities remain case-local and unchanged by adapter; no implicit population normalization occurs.
limitations: Tiny synthetic algebra/contract tests establish no patient transfer, clinical risk, anatomy approval, throughput or 16-GiB training-memory fit.
Observation adapter performs no intensity normalization; case-only preprocessing still belongs to its declared caller.
Source declarations cannot prove an upstream estimator did not use hidden labels; task-level hidden-truth invariance is separately required.
Observation fingerprint binds tensor/provenance content; source_id is separately joined in source receipts.
These checks do not assert CNN invariance to voxel-axis permutations or certify tool feasibility.
